description:
**Our most personalized experience** offers a private, one-on-one surf lesson tailored to your individual needs and goals. Experience the thrill of surfing with the undivided attention of your expert instructor. Our Private Surf Lesson provides an immersive ocean adventure designed to introduce you to surfing in a safe, unforgettable, and highly focused way.

We begin with a personalized land lesson, where your dedicated professional guide focuses solely on you. They will cover paddling, stance, ocean safety, wave selection, and how to pop up, all tailored to your specific skill level and learning style.

In the ocean, you'll benefit from unparalleled 1:1 attention, maximizing your wave-catching potential. Your instructor will be right by your side, providing immediate feedback and adjustments to help you progress quickly and confidently. They will share their passion for surfing and the ocean, ensuring a truly enriching experience.

The Private Surf Lesson is ideal for individuals seeking rapid improvement, those who prefer a more focused learning environment, or young children under the age of 10 who require the dedicated attention of a private instructor for safety and optimal learning. 

Here's what you can expect:
- Dedicated, professional surfing guide providing exclusive 1:1 instruction.
- Highly personalized land lesson focusing on your specific needs.
- Unwavering 1:1 in-water support for maximum wave-catching and personalized coaching.
- Personal photographer capturing your progress and memorable moments (available for purchase).
- Beginner-friendly surfboards and equipment.
- Safe, fun, and highly focused learning environment.
- Unforgettable personal achievement and rapid skill development.

Join us for a Private Surf Lesson and unlock your full surfing potential.

check_in_details:
Please meet us at our surf shop in “The Views” courtyard on the southern end of the Hotel Del Property. Please arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled start time to leave time to change, sign waivers, and answer any last-minute questions. We will be surfing at the beach directly in front of “The Views” building on the southern side of the jetty. Check in is 15 minutes prior to lesson start time and we provide secure lockers to store your belongings.
 
Many guests ask us if their experience or lesson will be taught and/or guided by Jamie O'Brien, and while Jamie does own and operate our surf school, he does not teach or guide himself. However, every instructor and guide has been hand selected by Jamie to provide you the safest and best experience possible, and they are eagerly waiting to get you in the water.

For Guests who are prone to motion or seasickness, please be advised that surfing, stand up paddling, and other activities offered by us have been known to trigger symptoms. Many guests are able to limit these by taking the motion sickness medication of their choice ~30 minutes before their experience.

Please keep in mind that ocean activities require concentration/focus and are ALWAYS enjoyed best sober. Guests who are visibly inebriated or suspected of being under the influence of drugs/alcohol may be denied service and asked to reschedule for safety reasons.

faqs:
**Will Jamie O’Brien be teaching my lesson?**
- While Jamie does own and operate our surf school, he does not teach or guide himself. However, every instructor and guide has been hand selected by Jamie to provide you the safest and best experience possible, and they are eagerly waiting to get you in the water.

**What is included in the experience?**
- All equipment needed for experience is provided, including surfboards, wetsuits, leashes, and surf wax.

**What are your lesson times and when is the best time to surf?**
- We offer lessons daily at 9:00 AM, 10:15 AM, 11:30 AM, 12:45 PM, 2:00 PM, and 3:15 PM, all lessons are 1.5 hours long. Due to our epic surfing location we enjoy great waves all day long, but many surfers prefer to surf at the earliest time slot available due to the joy of being out on the water during the morning glass.

**What happens during the lesson?**
- All lessons start with a 15 – 20 minute “land lesson” where you will learn ocean safety, surfing technique, and get familiar with the equipment. Once your instructor gives the green light, you’ll head out to the water to surf for 1 hour or more of riding waves followed by reviewing your photos at our surf shop.

**What is your payment and refund policy?**
- We require full payment upon booking, but you may cancel up to 48 hours prior to your lesson for a full refund. Changes to reservations made within the 48 hour window are not guaranteed but we will make best efforts to accommodate. 

**I’ve heard that Coronado has water quality issues, how does that effect my surf lesson?**
 - We follow San Diego County water quality protocols. The beach where we surf is tested every day by the County and based on their test the beach is either “open” or “closed”. If it’s “open” we will proceed with our lessons and if its “closed” we will contact you to reschedule and if necessary issue a refund. 

**I’m an advanced/intermediate surfer and looking to improve my surfing, can you help?**
- We specialize in teaching beginners and first-time surfers, and our surf break is best for learning the basics. We do not offer advanced surf coaching, but if you call our shop we will be able to refer you to someone who can assist.

**Which lesson type do you recommend?**
- While all of our lesson types guarantee an epic time, our most popular option by far is our Ohana (private group) lesson. Your family or group gets their own private instructor dedicated to just your group which allows more attention and personalized instruction. You’ll catch more waves than the public group lesson and you’ll save money per person vs the 1:1 private lesson. The Ohana lesson surfer to instructor ratio is 4:1 and is open to surfers of all ages, but surfers under 10 years old will need to pay $100 each additional for an extra instructor for safety reasons. 

**Why are you asking for my age, weight, and height?**
- We ask for this information so that we can ensure we have the right instructor ratio for you as well as pick the right surfboards for your lesson.

**Are there Age restrictions?**
- No, we can teach all ages from 2 to 99.  We require that children under 12 are in a private lesson one on one, or with their parents on an Ohana package.  If the guests are young children, around 6 years old and under they will often need to be on the board with the instructor (what we call a tandem lesson), and this will be a private lesson. If the guests are around 70 or older and feel they need the extra attention, a private lesson is advisable. Guests must be at least 12 years old to join a public group lesson.

**Can I surf if I get seasick?**
- For Guests who are prone to motion or seasickness, please be advised that surfing, stand up paddling, and other activities offered by us have been known to trigger symptoms. Many guests are able to limit these by taking the motion sickness medication of their choice ~60 minutes before their experience.

**What should I wear/do I need a bathing suit?**
- You will be provided a full body wetsuit to wear during your lesson, and while many people choose to wear nothing underneath, most guests will wear their swimsuit underneath the provided wetsuit. Private changing areas are provided. Please ensure you bring sunscreen and a towel.

**Where should we meet for our lesson, when should we be there, and where will we be surfing?**
- Please meet us at our surf shop in “The Views” courtyard on the southern end of the Hotel Del Property. Please arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled start time to leave time to change, sign waivers, and answer any last-minute questions. We will be surfing at the beach directly in front of “The Views” building on the southern side of the jetty.

**Are the instructors CPR certified?**
- Yes, all instructors are CPR and lifesaving certified.

**Will there be a photographer?**
- Yes, every lesson will be photographed, and the images will be available for purchase.
**Can I rent a surfboard if I don’t want to take a lesson and how much does it cost?**
- Yes, you can rent a board from our surf shop for $40/hr or $60/2 hrs. you can only surf on the southside of the jetty.

**I have a disability; can I take a surfing lesson?**
- Yes, we would love to take you surfing! We specialize in getting everyone out into the water regardless of age or ability. If the disability requires extra attention, you will need to take a private lesson.

**I can’t swim, can I take a surfing lesson?**
- Yes, we can certainly take you surfing. We do require for safety that non-swimmers take a private lesson one on one. To join our other lesson types, guests must be able to swim comfortably in the ocean without assistance or a lifejacket. We do have lifejackets available that non-swimmers may wear for their comfort during the lesson.
